definitions.explanation: The fundamental supporting structure of something, used figuratively for the core support of a family, organization, or system. Originally refers to the wooden frame of a festival float or stall.

examples.english: He is the backbone of the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{屋台骨|やたいぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧たちだ。
examples.english: It is the veteran employees who support the backbone of the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{屋台骨|やたいぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}らいでいる→揺らぐ：07601_yuragu⟧。
examples.english: The recession is shaking the very foundations of the country.

notes:
Originally refers to the wooden frame (⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ = bone, frame) of an ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧ (festival float or portable stall). Since this frame is what holds the entire structure together, the word came to mean the fundamental support of any organization or system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋台骨|やたいぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧: to support the backbone/foundation
- {屋台骨|やたいぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}らぐ→揺らぐ：07601_yuragu⟧: the foundation wavers
- {屋台骨|やたいぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}く→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧: the foundation tilts (i.e., is in trouble)
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{屋台骨|やたいぼね}: the pillar of the family

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}→大黒柱：18511_daikokubashira⟧: main pillar, breadwinner — similar metaphor but specifically for the central pillar of a house
- ⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧: foundation, base — more abstract and formal
- ⟦{礎|いしずえ}→礎：13729_ishizue⟧: cornerstone, foundation — more literary
